summary: The fuel pump relay may fail, causing the engine not to start or to stop while driving in petrol mode.
remedy: Dealer replaces the fuel pump relay free of charge. Takes about 1 hour.

summary: Charging control software can stop DC fast charging early and show code CHG-07 on some chargers.
remedy: Over-the-air update to software version 3.4.2 or later. Dealers can install it if the OTA update fails.

summary: The rear centre seat belt anchor bolt may not be tightened to specification.
remedy: Dealer inspects and re-torques the anchor bolt. Takes about 30 minutes.

summary: Passenger sun visor airbag warning label printed in the wrong language.
remedy: Dealer replaces the sun visor label.
